description: Estimate the eligible equipment cost for a FEMA Public Assistance claim from schedule rates you enter and hours in operation. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

lines.description: Equipment lines. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for equipment lines. Unknown is not the same as zero.

hours.description: Hours (or miles) in actual operation on eligible work (h or mi). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for hours (or miles) in actual operation on eligible work. Unknown is not the same as zero.

label.description: Equipment or reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for equipment or reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

rate.description: Rate per hour or per mile (your figure from the FEMA schedule) (US dollars). Find the item code and rate in the FEMA Schedule of Equipment Rates for the year that applies to the disaster.

standbyEligible.description: Standby approved as eligible for this line?. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for standby approved as eligible for this line?. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: no = No (FEMA generally does not reimburse standby); yes = Yes, approved in writing.

standbyHours.description: Standby hours (h). Time the equipment was available but not working.

standbyRate.description: Standby rate per hour (your approved figure) (currency/h). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for standby rate per hour (your approved figure). Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when standbyEligible is yes; ignored otherwise.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_fema_equipment_rate_billing_estimate

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.

title: FEMA equipment rate billing estimate
